reasoning: Shows a classic checkered racing flag on a pole. It is universally recognized for racing (running races, cycling, motorsports, karting) as well as finish lines, goals, and final project milestones. Because the outer white squares lack a bounding stroke, the unbordered checkerboard edge looks slightly fragmented at very small sizes, though the flagpole keeps it unmistakable.
